selection_rule: GCQ6 from June 1 through July 24. Require audited available current source, COMPLETE prepared session, all 840 London-to-New-York minutes observed, and the immediately previous weekday with the same contract, source admission, and complete observed window. June 19 and July 3 are shortened; June 22 and July 6 are retained only as context for subsequent selected dates. No outcomes, labels, target files, model scores or trading profits were consulted.
previous_context_rule: Use the immediately previous weekday only, without skipping back. A context-only date must have a complete current session for subsequent-day context; its own shortened prior weekday is not consumed as previous context for a selected origin.

disk.budget_basis: Conservative 3 GiB planning allowance using the existing 36-day v2 dataset size; canonical quotes and features remain shared, with no duplication required.

historical_exposure.evidence: spectrum/cognition/dataset.py assigns May-June 2026 to historical train and July 2026 to historical validation, and declares May-August source months. Exact prior execution of every selected date was not audited. This is a new chronological block relative to scientific-v2, without a never-inspected holdout claim.

limits: Metadata inventory plus Parquet footers only; no raw quote/trade tape, future labels, targets, outcomes, predictions or fitted models loaded.
Source metadata/manifests were hashed now; declared payload SHA values are lineage references, not a fresh full-payload raw audit. Builder must verify actual consumed payloads.
Observed-minute completeness is an availability criterion, not an authoritative exchange calendar or per-feature-known guarantee.
Both June 19 and July 3 remain overlay-eligible. Their exclusion is an explicit full-window research design choice based on 601/840 observed minutes.
Preserve causal available_ns, feature masks, true support epochs and quote invalid transitions; do not recreate v2 admission-driven memory resets.
All current capture schemas have 182 feature values and 182 known masks, plus 9 metadata columns. Not all 182 channels are known at every origin.
Exact trade-price VWAP is not newly materialized by this inventory.
